svg.title: Adhvik Rayaprolu — sketchbook scouting report
svg.desc: A colored-pencil sketch of a football pitch and a FIFA-style player card. Adhvik's projects are drawn as players in a 1-2-3-2 formation, and a ball passes from UIUC through research and AI products into the goal.
svg.text: formation 1-2-3-2 · every player is a real project
